claim: A DHCP option set can be associated with many VPCs, but each VPC can have only one DHCP option set at a time.
question: How many DHCP option sets can a VPC have, and can one set serve several VPCs?

values.display: each VPC can have only one associated DHCP option set
values.spoken: one DHCP option set per VPC

values.display: associate a DHCP option set with multiple VPCs

evidence.quote: You can associate a DHCP option set with multiple VPCs, but each VPC can have only one associated DHCP option set.
